fieldData.full-article-text: A feature of the Babylon release, Radix Developer Royalties will be a system that creates a new decentralised, on-ledger way for developers to generate on-going revenue for their contributions of on-ledger functionality to the Radix network that other developers may leverage. The Radix royalty system will make use of Radix Engine v2 and the Scrypto language.
